# Pull Request

<!--
  PR title = the squash commit title, in commitlint format with no scope:
  `type: #123 short description` (for example `feat: #12 route retry
  events`). A scope like `feat(router):` is rejected. Issue titles stay
  plain-language and skip the type prefix.

  Do not put `@` directly before an agent name (Claude, Codex) in the body
  unless you mean to trigger that agent on a supported GitHub surface.
-->
